title: game_scores encodes closed/loading/loaded as map presence and Option
trigger: Open and close a game's high-score panel
effect: absent = closed, Some(None) = loading, Some(Some) = loaded; callers insert and remove entries by hand (ui/message_games.rs) and the answer fills only an existing entry
fix: HashMap<(chat,msg), Fetch<Vec<GameHighScore>>> with an explicit Closed removal

title: Screen share stage is screen_share_pending and screen_sharing bools cleared together
trigger: Start or stop screen sharing in a group call
effect: Two bools plus screen_share_answer are reset by hand in two error arms and elsewhere
fix: enum ScreenShare{Off,Starting,On{answer},Stopping}

title: 1:1 call stage kept in answered_call, hang_up, second_call and active_call.state together
trigger: Answer, hang up, swap calls
effect: answered_call (Option<i32>) is a 'Pending but answered' flag beside ActiveCall.state; hang_up owns HangingUp beside it; second_call is an enum but depends on hang_up
fix: Put Answered inside CallState / ActiveCall phase so a single enum value holds it

title: Call privacy and recent-calls use a counter, error bools and a clearing bool
trigger: Open Calls settings and the Recent calls tab, Clear all
effect: privacy_pending counter + privacy_error bool; recent_calls_request + recent_calls_error + recent_calls_clearing bool are separate fields with their own clearers
fix: Fetch<..> for privacy and recent calls and a ClearCalls{request} stage

title: Folder share one-shot flags and errors: folder_link_saved bool, folder_share_error, folder_limit_hit drained by UI
trigger: A link create/edit or a failure sets a one-shot the UI drains on a poll
effect: Outcome is a bool/Option latch that any dialog can drain, not matched to a folder or request
fix: Push typed outcomes (with folder id) onto a queue like CommunitiesState::outcomes.

title: Add-folder-by-link dialog: link, info, error, done and request id are five fields moved together
trigger: Open an addlist link: check_folder_invite_link resets four fields by hand, sets the request id after the send; close_folder_invite resets four again but not folder_invite_request
effect: Stage (checking / checked / adding / done / failed) is implied by which of five fields is set; close leaves the request id set so a late answer still fills info after the dialog closed
fix: One enum FolderInvite { Idle, Checking{link,req}, Checked{link,info}, Adding{..}, Done, Failed{link,reason} } replaced whole on open/close.

title: Page retry: exhausted bool + retry Option per list (main, archive) with a separate folder set
trigger: LoadChats 404 sets chats_exhausted and clears retry; other errors set retry with doubling wait
effect: Paging stage (idle/loading/backoff/exhausted) is spread over chats_exhausted, chats_retry and PendingRequest presence
fix: enum PageStage { More, Backoff{until,wait}, Exhausted } per list; in-flight stays in the request table.

title: Archive settings panel: loading bool + open bool + Option settings kept in step by hand
trigger: Open Settings > Archive; fetch is sent and loading is set only when no cached copy exists; answer or error clears it
effect: Two bools plus an Option stand in for one fetch stage; a dropped answer leaves loading true
fix: Use Fetch<ArchiveChatListSettings> for the settings and keep the panel-open flag as a UI (OnScreen) field, not in Session.

title: chat_look_oks u32 counter: the chat colors dialog counts oks to know the save finished
trigger: Save in the chat colors dialog sends 1 to 3 requests; each ok bumps the counter, the dialog compares to the number it sent
effect: Counter is not matched to the dialog or the requests it sent, and an error leaves it short of the target
fix: Track the dialog's own request ids (set of RequestId) and finish when all are answered.

title: Deep-link flow split over deep_link, deep_link_original, deep_link_seq and deep_link_from_agent
trigger: A link opens: start sets four fields; terminal states are reached through six paths (Notice, limit box, web fallback, error, Ui, text); each path must reset original and the agent flag by hand
effect: deep_link=None is set on the wallet-notice and limit-box paths without clearing deep_link_from_agent or deep_link_original; correct only because every start re-sets them
fix: Fold original and from_agent into the DeepLinkState variants (or a DeepLinkFlow struct with a generation) so ending the flow drops all of it.

title: Community request tracking mixes in-flight table, notification_sends map and outcomes queue
trigger: setCommunityNotificationSettings: settings are parked in notification_sends under the request id; on ok moved into the full info; on error removed
effect: An entry is removed only on ok or error; a request settled another way (take_purpose, dropped continuation) leaves the entry and community_notification_settings keeps showing the unsent value
fix: Store the sent settings inside PendingRequest (or the purpose) so removing the request removes them.

title: Boost chain: boost_intent Option<i64> + boost_slots_by_chat + boost_box phase kept in step
trigger: Press Boost: intent set, slots fetched, boostChat sent; answers clear intent in two places (boost_flow.rs, error.rs)
effect: Stage lives in an Option as a started flag plus a per-chat stash, boost box phase, and note
fix: enum BoostFlow { Idle, FetchingSlots{chat}, Boosting{chat,slots}, Done } owned by the box.

title: Boost list page: loading bool + error + request id in BoostsListState
trigger: Open Boosts tab; page request sets loading and request; the reply clears loading, error and request together
effect: Three fields stand for one Fetch stage; the error arm in error.rs must clear them by hand
fix: Fetch<Page> with the request id in the Loading variant.

title: Invite member and join-request pages: loading bool + error + request id
trigger: Open an invite link's details; each page sets and clears the trio
effect: Same trio as boosts; clears only when the answering id matches
fix: Fetch<Page> with request id.

title: PublicLinkRevoke keeps requests and a failed bool in step by hand
trigger: Revoke in the limit box.
effect: failed is OR-ed as the two answers come and read when requests is empty; revoke Some/None plus public_chats Fetch and limit_box change together in settle_public_link_revoke.
fix: Enum Revoke { Waiting{chat, left: Vec<RequestId>, failed: bool-free via Outcome} } with Ok/Failed per request.

title: Username check is spread over check_generation, check_pending, check and check_failed
trigger: Typing a link in the Type box.
effect: Four fields kept in step by hand; the box derives 'Checking...', verdict and failed from them by text compare.
fix: One enum UsernameCheck { Idle, Checking{generation, chat, text}, Verdict(..), Failed{chat, text} }.

title: Member list paging is tracked by four maps kept in step by hand
trigger: Scroll or search the members list.
effect: supergroup_members, supergroup_member_queries, member_more_bases and member_more_failed must change together; a member_more_bases entry for a request that is never answered stays forever.
fix: One MemberList { query, first: RequestId, state: Fetch, more: Idle|Loading(RequestId)|Failed } per key.

title: The boost chain is split across boost_intent, boost_slots_by_chat and boost_box.phase
trigger: Press Boost: getAvailableChatBoostSlots then boostChat.
effect: boost_intent (global Option<i64>), cached slots and the box phase are advanced by the driver and the error arm separately; only GetBoostSlotsForBoost clears boost_intent on error.
fix: BoostBox owns an enum phase Main|AskingSlots{chat}|Boosting{chat, slot} and the intent goes away.

title: PendingBotMessage stop stage is can_stop, stopped and stop_failed bools
trigger: Stop a bot's streaming message.
effect: UpdatePendingMessage rebuilds the value from stopped and resets stop_failed=false and can_stop by hand.
fix: enum Stop { Available, Stopping, Stopped, Failed }.

title: Message link answer is result + is_public + error, three one-shot fields
trigger: Share link on a message then another before the UI drains
effect: message_link_public describes message_link_result but is a separate bool; error and result can both be set
fix: One Option<Result<MessageLink,String>> where MessageLink carries is_public.

title: Instant View fallback is a url plus a from-agent bool plus request sets
trigger: Open an Instant View link that 404s, from the agent and from the user
effect: instant_view_fallback_from_agent must describe instant_view_fallback_url; a second failure overwrites the url but the bool is from whichever came last
fix: Store Fallback{url,from_agent} as one Option and key the request table by RequestId to a struct holding url and origin.

title: Forward progress is an Option plus a Vec plus a last-result Option
trigger: Share a message to several chats at once
effect: First flight in in_flight_forward, the rest in queued_forward_flights, outcome in last_forward; kept in step by hand
fix: One Vec<Forward> where each entry is an enum Sending{request}/Done(result)/Failed, keyed by RequestId.

title: Sponsored report flow is two Options that must change together
trigger: Report a sponsored message, pick an option, or hit a TDLib error
effect: error.rs:266-269 clears both by hand; any other writer that clears one leaves the other
fix: enum SponsoredReport{Idle,Asking{target,flight},Done(outcome)}.

title: Gift market: auction_loading + auction_ready + auction_request, crafting + candidates_loading/loaded, search loading/loaded/error
trigger: Open an auction, the craft box and the resale list
effect: Each pair/triple is set in connect code and cleared in apply/error arms by hand (lines 56-59, 109-110, 141, 163, 262-265)
fix: Fetch<T>{request} per list and a Craft{Idle,Crafting{request},Done(result)} enum.

title: Grams hub page uses loading + error + request id
trigger: Switch Grams tabs while a page loads
effect: grams.loading, grams.error, grams.request, balance_nano/revenue Options are managed by hand (apply_page and the error arm); withdraw already uses an enum
fix: Fetch<Page> that carries the request id.

title: Checkout stage is form_loading + form_paid + verification_started + note + two request ids
trigger: Any checkout flow: open, validate order info, pay, 3-D Secure, close
effect: form_loading is set true by the driver and cleared in apply.rs:43, error.rs:24,31 and checkout.rs:13; form_paid and verification_started are cleared in different places; note is both error and success text
fix: enum Checkout{Closed,LoadingForm{request},Form{..},Validating{request},Paying{..},Paid,Verifying,Failed(note)}.

title: Star subscriptions dialog: loading, mutating, stale, error and offset as separate fields
trigger: Open Subscriptions, cancel one, scroll for the next page
effect: star_subscriptions_loading/mutating/stale/error/offset/subscriptions_open change in connect/payments.rs and apply.rs/error.rs by hand
fix: Fetch<Subscriptions> with a Mutating{id} sub-state and a stale marker inside Ready.

title: Recommended chats: recommended_loading + recommended_loaded
trigger: n/a
effect: Error clears loading only, so the Channels tab is neither loaded nor failed and retries only on the next filter change.
fix: Fetch<Vec<ChatId>>.

title: Date jump stages spread over date_jump, date_jump_pending, date_jump_note and the calendar
trigger: n/a
effect: A jump is resolved in date_jump, then pending in date_jump_pending, then landed; the note is a one-shot; the calendar box is a fourth Option.
fix: enum DateJump { Idle, Calendar(..), Resolving{..}, Loading{..}, Failed(note) } owned by the window's view.

title: SearchState open + recents + query + public_limits_exceeded select the surface by hand next to the derived status()
fix: Surface enum Closed | Recents | Query{..} | Browse.

title: TopicHistory paging stage is has_newer + newer_failed + loaded_complete + stale_pages
fix: A per-end PageEnd {More, Loading(id), Failed, Complete}.

title: ChatSearchState keeps open, chat_id, status, loading_more and jump in step by hand
trigger: begin_query sets open without chat_id; close/open_for/clear_query each reset a different subset.
fix: One enum Closed | Open{chat, query, stage} with the paging stage inside.

title: In-chat search stage is status + jump + loading_more + generation + open on one struct
trigger: Search in a chat, jump to a hit that is not loaded (Loading), page older hits (loading_more) and change the query meanwhile; each path resets a different subset.
effect: No bug found in this file; answers are matched by generation and chat.
fix: enum ChatSearch { Closed, Open{query, results: Fetch<Hits>, more: Fetch<()>, jump: ChatSearchJump} }.

title: A topic window's paging stage is spread over flags, a stale set and a session-wide failure set
trigger: Forum topic paging.
effect: loaded_complete, has_newer, newer_failed, stale_pages, history_pruning.gone_topic_pages and threads.topic_load_failed together describe each end's fetch.
fix: Per end: enum EndState { Complete, More, Loading{request}, Failed }, with stale requests dropped by request id on the window.

title: InviteLinkMembersState keeps loading bool beside error and request
trigger: Open who joined through a link
effect: loading/error/request can disagree (state/info_types.rs:356)
fix: Fetch<T>-style enum Loading{request}/Loaded/Failed

title: Forum topic first page state is split between threads.topic_load_failed set and TopicHistory.loaded_complete
trigger: n/a
effect: Loading, failed, empty and loaded are inferred from a set membership and fields of a separate map entry, cleared in separate places (session_forum.rs, connect/groups/forum.rs).
fix: One `TopicLoad { Loading(RequestId), Failed, Loaded{complete} }` per (chat, topic) in TopicHistory.

title: HistoryCalendar has loading bool with exhausted bool and generation
trigger: Open Jump to date, change month
effect: loading/exhausted/oldest_loaded are kept in step by hand (state/history_calendar.rs:54)
fix: enum Pages { Loading{gen}, More, Exhausted }

title: Calendar paging stage is loading + exhausted + generation set by hand from the driver
trigger: fetch_calendar_page sets calendar.loading = true after request(); accept/fail clear it; a request whose answer never matches the generation (box reopened, chat changed) leaves loading true for the old box only.
effect: No bug today, but loading, exhausted and the oldest_loaded cursor must change together (accept compares oldest == before to infer exhaustion).
fix: enum CalendarPaging { Idle, Loading{generation}, Exhausted, Failed } with the cursor inside.

title: Calendar fetch stage is loading + exhausted bools plus a generation, and the date jump is date_jump_pending + chat_search.jump + date_jump + date_jump_note
trigger: Open the calendar and page back; or start a date jump while a search jump is loading.
effect: Both can be set at once (loading and exhausted), and the jump pipeline has no single stage value; each writer clears the pieces it knows about (abandon_history_around clears pending and jump separately).
fix: HistoryCalendar::pages: enum { Idle, Loading(RequestId), Exhausted }; one DateJump enum { None, Waiting{chat,message,mode}, Landing(ViewJump), Failed(note) }.

title: Business time zones / chat links / bot: *_requested bools, saving counters
trigger: n/a
effect: time_zones_requested, chat_links_requested, connected_bot_requested are set at send and reset in error arms; chat_links_saving is a u32 incremented by sends and decremented by answers.
fix: Fetch<Vec<TimeZone>>, Fetch<Vec<ChatLink>>, Fetch<Option<ConnectedBot>>; saves as request-id sets.

title: Quick replies: shortcuts_requested bool and messages_requested/messages_failed sets
trigger: n/a
effect: Failed message loads stay in both sets until reopen() drains messages_failed.
fix: Fetch<Vec<..>> for shortcuts and HashMap<i32, Fetch<Vec<QuickReplyMessage>>> for messages.
